# Accepted capabilities

### capability-route-planner-capacity-and-ordering
## Route planning

Builds a date-scoped route plan, validates each selected request, enforces daily capacity and orders stops using a configured priority depot and stable tie-breakers.

Claims:
- [claim-plan-workflow](claims/p-315e303cf318-001.md#claim-claim-plan-workflow)
- [claim-plan-ordering](claims/p-315e303cf318-001.md#claim-claim-plan-ordering)
- [claim-plan-model](claims/p-315e303cf318-001.md#claim-claim-plan-model)

### capability-route-planner-json-boundary
## Route plan JSON boundary

Reads camelCase slot-request dictionaries from stdin and serializes route plans with routeDate, totalBoxes and ordered stop fields.

Claims:
- [claim-plan-serialization](claims/p-315e303cf318-001.md#claim-claim-plan-serialization)
